dining_june_total.description: Dining/eating out/coffee total for June as written in the answer, e.g. "212.74". null if not reported.

dining_july_total.description: Dining/eating out/coffee total for July. null if not reported.

dining_august_total.description: Dining/eating out/coffee total for August. null if not reported.

dining_august_budget_status.description: What the answer says about August dining versus the dining budget.

shopping_july_total.description: Shopping total for July as reported. null if not reported.

refund_treatment.description: How the answer treats the REI refund (-$68.00).

duplicate_flagged.description: true only if the answer explicitly identifies the repeated Trader Joe's $54.12 entry on July 22 as a likely duplicate.

both_delta_charges_kept.description: true if the answer counts both Delta Air Lines charges ($412.60 and $450.60); false if it drops or merges one; null if the answer gives no way to tell.

travel_august_total.description: Travel total for August as reported. null if the answer has no travel category or total.

uncategorized_entry_count.description: How many transfer/ATM/Venmo/Zelle/PayPal entries the answer leaves uncategorized (flagged rather than assigned to a spending category). null if the answer does not make this determinable.

largest_july_to_august_increase_category.description: The category the answer identifies as having the largest increase from July to August. null if not stated.
